cues: Gibberellin also makes genetically dwarf peas grow tall, breaks the dormancy of seeds and buds, and switches on the enzyme alpha-amylase in germinating barley, which is the basis of malting.
Sprayed on Thompson Seedless grapes, it makes the berries bigger and the bunch looser.
